tool: ChatGPT image generation through the Codex CLI (codex-images.ps1)
style: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border.

cards.prompt: A 3:2 landscape illustration for the background of a small app card. Match the attached reference images exactly in style: flat hand-drawn screen-print illustration, near-black background, coral-red and salmon-pink liquid swirling contour lines, fine speckled dot texture, same palette and line weight. Subject: one single long unbroken filmstrip that curls and loops through the air as one continuous ribbon, its frames blank and glowing softly. Put the subject in the right half of the frame; let the left third fall away to almost plain black with only faint thin swirls, so text can sit there. Do not copy the reference composition; only its look.
